newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index crawls up in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index crawls up in thin volume.

text.p: The share index at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius crawled 0.39 points up to 321.79 on Monday with transactions remaining thin as small deals across the market characterised trading, brokers said.
Transactions totalled 1.64 million rupees on 67,352 shares from 4.57 million rupees on 153,570 shares on Friday.
"It's still the status quo on the market," one broker said. "The thin volume says it all on investors' (subdued) mood."
The broker said foreign investors bought Mauritius Breweries stock owing to their attractive price level. Mauritius Breweries gained one rupee to 126 on 1,500 shares.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 73 rupees on 10,015 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was stable at 8.40 rupees on 22,700 shares.

British American Insurance remained at 7.50 rupees on 4,000 shares. Investment-based Fincorp rose one rupee to 73 on 100 shares and Promotion And Development (PAD) rose 10 cents to 15.80 rupees on 2,000 shares.
National Investment Trust was unchanged at 12.50 rupees on 5,000 shares while sugar-based Savannah (preference) lost 1.50 rupees to 95.50 on 50 shares.
Conglomerate Rogers was unchanged at 94.50 rupees on 575 shares while Ireland Blyth was 10 cents higher at 13.10 rupees on 742 shares.
Happy World Foods lost 10 cents to 14.20 rupees on 3,716 shares but oil company Shell (Mauritius) gained 10 cents to 15.30 rupees on 800 shares.
New Mauritius Hotels shed 10 cents to 27.90 rupees on 1,000 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged at 51 rupees on 580 shares.
